name: blueprint/transit-status
description: Transit status as heartbeats: keyless status feeds per operator, one receipt per line, delay thresholds alert once
recipe: fetch the operator's status feed -> normalize per line -> store receipts -> threshold crossing: notify once
pitfalls: feeds vary per operator - probe each one first
delays are thresholded - a 2-minute delay is not an alert
a feed that dies is itself a heartbeat failure
